questions.q: Recite Al-Fajr 89:13 to 18 together, holding the madd lazim in 89:18 for 6 counts.
questions.a: The class recites 89:13 to 18 with the long madd in تَحَٰٓضُّونَ.

questions.q: Recitation check: today's group recites Al-Balad and Al-Fajr 89:1 to 18 to the teacher. Everyone else completes the madd spotting task on the pupil PDF.
questions.a: Rubric marked; madd task answers on the teacher sheet.

questions.q: Extend: write your target for next half term.
questions.a: For example: 'I will keep munfasil at 4 counts every time.'
A) Munfasil. Yaa at the end of رَبِّىٓ, hamza at the start of the next word: munfasil.

questions.q: Madd muttasil and munfasil are both ...
Think again: Look back at this half term. Which ayah are you proudest to have learned, and why?
questions.a: Answers vary: perhaps 90:17 on patience and mercy, or 89:1 on the dawn.
